title: Sources Sought Notice: M11 Small Arms Storage Rack (NSN: 1095-00-897-8755)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC- DTA
detail_text: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE / MARKET RESEARCH SURVEY The Army Contracting Command - Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) is seeking to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities, and qualifications of various members of the community, to include both small and large businesses, for production of the following: M11 SMALL ARMS STORAGE RACK NATIONAL STOCK NUMBER: 1095-00-897-8755 PART NUMBER: 8429990 PRODUCTION QUANTITY: 117 EA OPTION QUANTITY: Up to 100% FIRST ARTICLE TEST REPORT: Required The Government intends to solicit this item via the Basic Ordering Agreement Sustainment Track (BOAST) program. If your firm is not a current BOA holder, please visit the following link for additional information: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/0f7e97dee3894c1fb1a196dce02fec28/view Responses to the subject survey will assist ACC-DTA in planning for a potential contract. Interested vendors are encouraged to complete the survey located under "Attachments/Links" and return via email to: Stanley Biernacki Contract Specialist, ACC-DTA Email: stanley.r.biernacki.civ@army.mil Subject Line: "Storage Rack Survey Response" All survey responses must be received no later than Friday, 22-May-2026 at 1:00 p.m. local time (Warren, MI) . NOTE: The associated technical data package (TDP) will only be made available to vendors if/when a solicitation is released.
